Ten years in prison, and he still called it a gift.

Kevin Trudeau says he was sentenced for contempt of court, which he points out is not a misdemeanor or a felony. He sat there shocked at the length of the sentence.

Then he made a choice. He told himself adversity is a gift. He says he did not know why yet, but he decided to believe it anyway.

When did you last choose your attitude before you knew the outcome?

#ad #mindset #fear #kevintrudeau

Guards asked how he stayed calm. His answer: your mind.

Kevin Trudeau describes using a technique he knew while guards walked by and watched in amazement. One asked how he was doing it. Kevin's answer: you can train your mind to do anything.

He says he did not let the adversity control him. He took charge of it instead.

What would change if you trained your mind the way you train your body?
